rules.grid: 2:1 diamond, tile top 64x32 (1x) / 128x64 (2x), height step 10 px

light.faces: SW (left) faces lit, SE (right) faces in shade

conflicts.note: WP10a says 12-frame sail strip; WP10 (older asset table) says "sail strip 16 f"; Crosshaven ships 16 f (windmill_sails) and 48 f (windmill_sails_v5). Manifest follows WP10a/your brief: 12 frames.
WP10a: meadow x3, orchard soil x2, tilled rows x2 (matches your list). WP10 table (Proposed counts): meadow x4, orchard_soil x3 + autotile edges and corners; no tilled rows. Manifest follows WP10a.
WP10a matches your list. WP10 table: white_flagstone x4, snow_grass x3, cliff_white edges; no glossy ice. Manifest follows WP10a.

Crosshaven blends materials with <family>_edge_<sides> (15) + <family>_corner_<c> (4). WP10a lists none, so orchard soil / tilled rows / flagstone / ice beside meadow or snow grass will meet in hard diamond seams. The tile script can make edge sets from the same swatches (no extra paint): see wp10a_tiles.py --edges.

Stand-in chunks use dirt_road for paths. WP10a gives Rowanvale no road/path material. Proposal: keep Crosshaven dirt_road for Rowanvale paths (farm tracks), or paint one more swatch (rutted farm track). Windmere: white_flagstone works as the path material.

conflicts.topic: 2x1 size class unused in this pair
conflicts.note: The low stone wall is now 1x1 per axis (one cell long, like Crosshaven stone_wall_low_nwse/_nesw and the pass-2 paints), so no Rowanvale/Windmere asset uses the 96x80 2x1 class. For later pairs (mossy log, carts): 96x80 equals the 2x1 footprint width but the bottom-centre anchor on the south tip needs 128x80 (art spans -64..+32 px around the tip, like Crosshaven market_stall 134 px), or keep 96x80 and anchor at x=64 (nwse) / x=32 (nesw).

conflicts.topic: Walls and hedges: one axis in the spec, two needed
conflicts.note: WP10a names both axes only for the wooden fence (nwse / nesw). The low stone wall and the orchard hedge are listed once. Crosshaven ships stone_wall_low_nwse/_nesw and hedgerow_nwse/_nesw, and wall runs and the 1-2 cell border band follow both iso axes, so the manifest adds stone_wall_field_nesw and border_orchard_hedge_nesw (paint them, do not mirror: mirroring moves the top-left key light to the top-right). Pine walls (Windmere) are orientation-free tree masses and need no second axis.

Stasium Bot sizes have no border class. Orchard hedge: 1x1 segment per axis on the small canvas (64x64 / 128x128), chained like Crosshaven hedgerow_* (116 px wide at 2x), target width 112 px at 2x. Snowy pine wall: proposed 96x128 / 192x256, 1x1 footprint, overlapping neighbours by 16 px (1x) like border_forest_*.
WP10a says Old Windmill is 2x2 (not "tall"), the hero row says 3x3 or 2x2 tall at 192x256. Manifest uses the hero canvas (192x256) for both heroes since they are the region hero landmarks.
WP10a: "Animated pieces (lava, bubbles, arcs, beacons) use 12-frame strips". Crosshaven sway strips are 16 f @ 8 fps. Manifest keeps 16 f for *_sway (Crosshaven convention), 12 f for the sail strip.

conflicts.topic: Shadow sway vs no cast shadows
conflicts.note: Spec asks for <prop>_shadow_sway; in Crosshaven these are separate ground-layer cast-shadow strips (#1a223c, projected from the top-left). Nothing is baked into the sprite, so it does not break the no-baked-cast-shadow rule.

Spec names assets in prose only. Manifest ids are Crosshaven-style snake_case, chosen not to collide with existing Crosshaven ids (tree_apple, hay_bale, fence_wood_*, scarecrow, stone_wall_low_*, bush_flower, lamp_post exist there). Each entry names the Crosshaven stand-in id the placer uses until the art lands.

conflicts.topic: Windmere grade will crush painted art
conflicts.note: windmere/stand_in.json now has saturation 0.58, blue tint 0.55, haze 0.3 (tuned for golden_plains stand-ins). Painted snow and ice under that grade will turn grey-blue; paint natural colour and have the Technical Artist re-tune the grade when the art lands.
scenes/world/crosshaven/{crosshaven_art,crosshaven_ground,crosshaven_prop}.gd hard-code res://art/world/crosshaven/. Region roots need a code change (world agent).

origin/claude/pc-zones-spec is now b7027d0 (two commits after a4f667e: mission XP rules in 4.7/4.8 and the PC set stat budget). WP10/WP10a are unchanged; WP10a sits at lines 1704-1801 in the new file.

The painter uses short names (apple_tree_a.png, fence_nwse.png, stone_wall_low.png, orchard_hedge.png ...). Each manifest entry lists raw_aliases; the scripts take <id>.png first, then the aliases. raw/wp10a_rowanvale/pass1/ (scenes on grass) is ignored.
